PLD 2021 SC 450.title: Tariq Bashir v. The State
PLD 2021 SC 450.snippet: Further inquiry under Section 497(2) CrPC entitles the accused to bail as of right.

2019 SCMR 120.title: Shahbaz Sharif v. National Accountability Bureau
2019 SCMR 120.snippet: Prohibitory clause of Section 497 CrPC applies strictly where prima facie reasonable grounds exist.
